subject: Decision on pilot scope & scheduling — request to retire if not moving
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@openfintech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & next steps from demo — pilot scope and timing

Hi Marta,

Great to meet yesterday — appreciate you and the team walking through OpenFintech's fraud-detection workflow. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we don't lose momentum: 

- Scope: 2 models to evaluate (transactional prompt scoring + account-level reranking) for a 30-day pilot, limited to anonymized transactions.
- Success metrics: 95% precision at threshold X and <100ms p50 inference for 2k qps load.
- Infra: Redwood Dedicated in eu-west for data residency; we'll provide a scoped SOW for legal/procurement.
- Timeline: target kick-off the week of Nov 8 to align with your post-quarter review.

Next concrete items from our side (attached):
- SOW_draft_v2.pdf — scope & acceptance criteria (Ben drafted)
- Redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx — committed capacity options and pilot pricing

Could you confirm whether the proposed scope & the Nov 8 timing still look feasible for Procurement and the security folks? If you'd like, Ben and I can join a 30-minute scheduling call with your procurement lead next week.

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183

Attachments: SOW_draft_v2.pdf (application/pdf), Redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Subject: Closing the loop — should I archive this opportunity?

Hi Marta —

Wanted to close the loop on our pilot conversation. I know you mentioned a procurement freeze and potential slip to early Q1 — completely understand. To help us manage headcount and reserved capacity, can you confirm one of the following by EOD next Wednesday (Nov 24)?

1) Still interested — please reply with an estimated decision window (e.g., early Q1, mid-Q1) and whether Procurement needs any additional docs (I can get Ben to pull answers for security's questions on retention & KV cache).
2) Not a fit / deprioritized — we'll archive the opportunity and re-engage in Q1. No hard feelings.

If I don't hear back, I'll plan to archive the file and free up the pilot slot later this month. If a quick sync with Procurement/security helps, Ben and I can take that meeting — we want to make this as frictionless as possible.

Thanks for your time and transparency —
